extracted.intended_audience: prospective Vanier CGS doctoral applicants and nominating Canadian institutional administrators
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and requirements for nomination, eligibility, and selection for the Vanier Canada Graduate Scholarships (doctoral-level). Covers selection criteria, nomination rules, eligible research areas, citizenship eligibility, and award value/duration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Academic Excellence
rubrics_metrics.description: One of three equally weighted selection criteria: Academic Excellence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed on the page as a core selection dimension; evaluated alongside Research Potential and Leadership. No further detail provided on this page (see full guidelines for scoring).

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Potential
rubrics_metrics.description: One of three equally weighted selection criteria: Research Potential.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed on the page as a core selection dimension; evaluated alongside Academic Excellence and Leadership. No further detail provided on this page (see full guidelines for scoring).

rubrics_metrics.name: Leadership (potential and demonstrated ability)
rubrics_metrics.description: One of three equally weighted selection criteria: Leadership (potential and demonstrated ability).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Leadership is assessed for both demonstrated achievements and future potential; it is equally weighted with Academic Excellence and Research Potential.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nomination requirement by Canadian institution (quota)
rubrics_metrics.description: Candidates must be nominated by a Canadian institution with a quota to host Vanier scholars. Candidates should only seek a nomination from the institution at which they want to study.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The term 'quota' refers to the maximum number of nominations an institution can forward to the national competition. Nomination by an eligible Canadian institution is mandatory; applicants cannot self-nominate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Citizenship eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Citizenship: Canadian citizens; Permanent residents of Canada; Foreign citizens.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This page lists acceptable citizenship statuses; applicants should 'View all eligibility details' on the full eligibility page for particulars, residency proofs, or restrictions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligible areas of research
rubrics_metrics.description: Areas of research: Health research; Natural sciences and/or engineering; Social sciences and humanities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must be pursuing doctoral research in one of these broad research areas. See full eligibility details for more granular guidance on discipline fit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award value and duration
rubrics_metrics.description: Valued at $50,000 per year for three years during doctoral studies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies the monetary value and term of the scholarship award; additional terms and conditions (e.g., payment schedule, hold/deferral rules) are not detailed on this page.
